title: Advanced Hook Patterns
description: Explore advanced React hook patterns including reducer hooks, imperative handles, layout effects, and custom hook testing.
longDescription: This module covers advanced React hook patterns and best practices. You will learn to use useReducer for complex state logic, useImperativeHandle for exposing imperative methods, useLayoutEffect for DOM measurements, createReducer for reusable reducer logic, and strategies for testing custom hooks effectively.
whatYouLearn: Use useReducer for complex state transitions and action dispatching
Expose imperative methods to parent components with useImperativeHandle
Apply useLayoutEffect for DOM measurements and synchronous updates
Test custom hooks with React Testing Library and Jest
Follow best practices for hook design, naming, and documentation
